dateline: Bogotá declared BTS Honorary Guests on Oct 1 ahead of the sold-out ARIRANG World Tour shows at El Campín on Oct 2-3, the opener of the Latin American leg.
heroHeadline: Day 4,858: BTS Land in Bogotá as ARIRANG Tour Tops $500M in Ticket Sales
heroSubtitle: October 1, 2026 is Day 4,858 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. BTS arrived in Bogotá on Sept 30 ahead of the Oct 2-3 El Campín shows that open the ARIRANG World Tour's Latin American leg, followed by Lima, Santiago, La Plata and São Paulo. The tour was reported to have passed $500 million in ticket sales, a first for a pop group.
